blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines made easy work of winless University of the East, 101-70, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym on Sunday. The Fighting Maroons regained control of the top seed at 7-2 with a half-game lead over National University (6-2). The Red Warriors’ misery continued, dropping to 0-9 this season and absorbing their 29th consecutive defeat since Season 87.
